dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a set E in a measurable space, LocalDef001 E is the real-valued indicator function of E with constant value 1 on E.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the function evaluated at ω in both conclusions: it should equal real 1 when ω belongs to E and real 0 when ω does not belong to E.

dependency_coverage.name: And
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target requires both conditional pointwise equalities to hold simultaneously.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: Equality between two objects of the same type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses equality in the real numbers between LocalDef001 E ω and either 1 or 0.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasurableSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: A measurable-space structure on the type Ω.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is an implicit instance parameter required by LocalDef001, although the pointwise claim imposes no measurability condition on E.

dependency_coverage.name: Membership.mem
dependency_coverage.meaning: The generic membership relation determined by a Membership instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With the set-membership instance, it forms the proposition that ω belongs to E.

dependency_coverage.name: Not
dependency_coverage.meaning: Logical negation: Not P means that P implies false.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses the assumption that ω does not belong to E in the second implication.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The mechanism interpreting a natural-number numeral in a type possessing the appropriate numeral instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It participates in interpreting the displayed numerals 1 and 0 as real numbers.

dependency_coverage.name: One.toOfNat1
dependency_coverage.meaning: The construction interpreting the numeral 1 from a One instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the value 1 in the first equality the multiplicative unit of the real numbers.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the codomain of LocalDef001 and the type in which both equalities are asserted.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard One instance on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets the numeral 1 as the real number one.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instZero
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard Zero instance on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the real zero used by the indicator function and by the second equality.

dependency_coverage.name: Set
dependency_coverage.meaning: A set of elements of a type α is represented as a predicate α → Prop.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes E an arbitrary subset of Ω.

dependency_coverage.name: Set.instMembership
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard membership instance for sets, under which x ∈ E means that the predicate E holds at x.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the precise meanings of ω ∈ E and its negation in the two antecedents.

dependency_coverage.name: Zero.toOfNat0
dependency_coverage.meaning: The construction interpreting the numeral 0 from a Zero instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the value 0 in the second equality the real additive zero.

dependency_coverage.name: Set.indicator
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a set s and function f, s.indicator f is the function sending x to f x when x belongs to s and to zero otherwise.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Applied to E and the constant real-valued function 1, it defines LocalDef001 E ω to be 1 on E and 0 outside E.

binders: For every type Ω, equipped implicitly with a measurable-space structure
and for every point ω ∈ Ω
hypotheses: If ω belongs to E, for the first implication
if ω does not belong to E, for the second implication
conclusions: If ω ∈ E, then LocalDef001 E ω = 1 in the real numbers.
If ω ∉ E, then LocalDef001 E ω = 0 in the real numbers.
Both of these implications hold as a conjunction.
mathematical_definitions: LocalDef001 E is the real-valued indicator function of E obtained by applying the set indicator operation to the constant function x ↦ 1.
Thus LocalDef001 E ω is defined to be 1 when ω ∈ E and 0 when ω ∉ E.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For any measurable space Ω, any subset E of Ω, and any point ω of Ω, the real-valued indicator of E at ω equals 1 if ω lies in E, and equals 0 if ω does not lie in E.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The set E is arbitrary; the proposition does not assume that E is measurable.
No property of the measurable-space structure is asserted or used in the stated pointwise conclusions beyond supplying the instance expected by LocalDef001.
Each conclusion is an implication and is therefore individually vacuous when its antecedent is false.
Because the two implications are conjoined, the proposition records both branches of the indicator definition, but it does not itself state the disjunction ω ∈ E or ω ∉ E.
The equalities are real-number equalities; the numerals 1 and 0 are interpreted in Real.
The proposition is only a pointwise value characterization and does not assert measurability, integrability, continuity, or any other global property of the indicator function.
ambiguities: There is no substantive ambiguity once LocalDef001 is expanded as the real-valued indicator of E; its generated local name carries no independent mathematical meaning.
